name: Shadowrocket
description:
Rule based proxy utility client for iPhone/iPad.

- Capture all HTTP/HTTPS/TCP traffic from any applications on your device, and redirect to the proxy server.
- Record and display HTTP, HTTPS, DNS requests from your iOS devices.
- Configure rules using domain match, domain suffix, domain keyword, CIDR IP range, and/or GeoIP lookup.
- Measure traffic usage and network speed on WiFi, cellular, direct and proxy connections.
- Import rule files from URL or iCloud Drive.
- Block ads by domain, user agent rules.
- Local DNS Mapping.
- Work on cellular networks.
- Decrypt HTTPS traffic.
- Perform URL rewrite.
- Fully IPv6 supports.
- Script filter supports.
- Multi-level forward proxy.
- Support kcptun, cloak, gost, v2ray plugins.
- Support DNS over HTTPS, DNS over TLS, DNS over QUIC.
release_notes:
* feat(protocol): add Sudoku proxy protocol support and optimize data-path forwarding to reduce memory allocations and buffer copying
* feat(dns): support dedicated DNS routing for direct domains, DNS over TCP, DNSCrypt upstreams, and multiple servers in CNAME/Host rules
* feat(tailscale): migrate login to TS2021, support subnet routing and exit nodes, and introduce low-power tunnel suspension on demand
* feat(protocol): support Clash SSH/packetaddr subscription imports
* feat(macos): add menu bar routing controls and quick server configurations for macOS
* feat(group): add an independent ping-based auto-sort option for policy groups
* perf(transport): handle KCP backpressure, harden WireGuard/Hysteria packet security, and restore full upload throughput on QUIC transports
* fix(vpn): prevent tunnel startup hangs, preserve local device connectivity, and prevent stale speedtests from resetting VPN states
* fix(dns): route host resolutions and QUIC endpoints through tunnel resolver, and reuse H2 addresses for H3 upgrades
* fix(tailscale): advertise disco keys for direct paths, respect custom DERP TLS verification, and fix battery drain when VPN is disconnected
* fix(rule): fix remote rule set refreshes, preserve quoted rewrite tokens during parsing/export, and guard compiled policy group updates
* fix(system): support WebKit scoped globals and fetch polyfills in scripts, and apply tombstone-based iCloud manifest to prevent configuration rollbacks
* fix(system): prevent WKWebView/JavaScriptCore teardown crashes and limit proxy stream memory growth to prevent OOM


Please note: Shadowrocket is a standalone networking utility and does not include any proxy services or server resources. Users are responsible for providing their own configurations.
